function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – What’s Trending, What Works, and Why Below is a quick‑reference guide to the most popular men’s underwear styles, what they’re best for, and a few tips on choosing the right fit for your body type and lifestyle. | Style | Key Features | Best For | Pros | Cons | |-------|--------------|----------|------|------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Long‑leg, snug fit; elastic waistband; often made of cotton, modal, or microfiber | Everyday wear, sports, travel | • Good support, minimal bunching
• Versatile for all seasons | • Can feel restrictive if too tight
• May show seams under tight pants | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short leg, snug waistband; “V” cut | Work, casual, gym | • Excellent support
• Minimal visible lines | • Less coverage, may feel exposed in hot weather | | **Boxers** | Loose fit, longer leg; elastic or drawstring waist | Sleep, lounging, light activity | • Breathable, relaxed feel
• Great for hot climates | • Can bunch up under tight pants
• Less support | | **Trunks** | Shorter leg than briefs, snug fit; similar to boxer briefs but shorter | Sports, everyday wear | • Combines support with a modern look
• Less bulk than boxer briefs | • May not suit very tall or very short legs | | **Jockstrap** | Supportive pouch with a waistband and a thin elastic strap | Athletic, high‑impact sports | • Excellent support for active use
• Minimal fabric reduces heat | • Not suitable for everyday casual wear | | **Compression Shorts** | Tight, full‑length; often made of spandex blends | Post‑workout recovery, cycling, running | • Reduces muscle vibration
• Keeps everything in place | • Can feel restrictive if too tight
• Not ideal for everyday wear | | **Bamboo/Modal** | Made from natural fibers; soft, breathable | Sensitive skin, eco‑friendly | • Hypoallergenic, moisture‑wicking
• Sustainable | • Can be pricier
• May shrink if not cared for properly | | **Performance Tech** | Advanced fabrics (e.g., Coolmax, Dri‑Fit) | High‑intensity workouts | • Excellent moisture management
• Keeps you dry | • Usually more expensive
• Limited style options | | **Lace/Sheer** | Decorative, often sheer or lace‑trimmed | Special occasions, fashion | • Adds a touch of flair
• Can be surprisingly comfortable | • Not practical for everyday wear
• May not offer much support | --- ## How to Pick the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** - **Low‑impact or everyday use:** Boxer briefs or trunks for a balance of comfort and support. - **High‑impact sports:** Jockstrap or compression shorts for maximum support. - **Sleep or lounging:** Boxers or loose briefs for breathability. 2. **Think About Your Wardrobe** - **Tight‑fitting pants:** Boxer briefs or trunks to avoid visible seams. - **Loose or relaxed pants:** Boxers or briefs work fine. 3. **Body Shape & Comfort** - **Tall or long‑legged:** Trunks or longer boxer briefs to avoid bunching. - **Short or small build:** Boxers or briefs with a lower rise to avoid excess fabric. 4. **Fabric Matters** - **Cotton:** Soft, breathable, but can absorb sweat. - **Microfiber/Modal:** Moisture‑wicking, less prone to pilling. - **Bamboo:** Eco‑friendly, naturally antibacterial. - **Spandex blends:** Provide stretch and shape retention. 5. **Fit & Waistband** - Look for a waistband that’s snug but not tight—no digging or rolling. - Elastic waistbands with a small amount of stretch tend to stay in place better. --- ## Trending Picks (2024) | Brand | Style | Why It’s Trending | |-------|-------|-------------------| | **Uniqlo** | Ultra Stretch Boxer Briefs | Affordable, high‑quality fabric, minimal seams | | **Calvin Klein** | Classic Briefs | Iconic design, excellent support | | **Lululemon** | Align Compression Shorts | Premium performance fabric, sleek look | | **Tommy John** | Second Skin Boxer Briefs | Seamless, breathable, great for travel | | **Patagonia** | Breathe‑Tech Performance Tech | Sustainable materials, moisture‑wicking | | **H&M** | Eco‑Friendly Bamboo Boxers | Budget‑friendly, eco‑conscious | --- ## Quick FAQ | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | **Do I need a different style for each season?** | Not necessarily. Breathable fabrics (cotton, bamboo) work year‑round, but you might prefer lighter fabrics in summer and thicker blends in winter. | | **Can I wear boxer briefs under a suit?** | Yes—choose a low‑rise, seamless pair to avoid visible lines. | | **What’s the best fabric for sensitive skin?** | Bamboo or modal are hypoallergenic and less likely to cause irritation. | | **How often should I replace my underwear?** | Every 6–12 months, or sooner if you notice wear, loss of elasticity, or fabric pilling. | --- ### Bottom Line - **Boxer briefs** are the all‑rounder for most men—supportive, versatile, and comfortable. - **Briefs** are great if you want maximum support and minimal coverage. - **Boxers** are perfect for relaxed, breathable wear. - **Trunks** give a modern look with less bulk than boxer briefs. - **Performance fabrics** and **compression styles** are essential for athletes or those who sweat a lot. Pick the style that matches your daily activities, wardrobe, and personal comfort. Happy underwear hunting!
